data.narrative:
Arbe Robotics operates in the Drones & Autonomous sector at the public stage, having raised $118M in total funding. The comparable universe consists of eight private peers in the same sector, including Joby Aviation, Archer Aviation, Waymo, Wayve, and Zipline. No public peers trade in this specific market segment.

Peer-median valuation methodology is not applicable to this analysis. The Drones & Autonomous sector contains only seven same-sector comparables globally, and of these, fewer than three meet narrow filtering criteria (same stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier). A median derived from such a small and heterogeneous set would lack statistical reliability and would misrepresent Arbe's valuation floor or ceiling. Applying an all-sector median as a fallback introduces excessive noise given the diverse business models, technology maturity, and commercial stage across the broader universe.

The scarcity of same-stage, similarly-valued public and private peers limits the quantitative triangulation approaches typically available for frontier-tech valuations. To establish a defensible range for Arbe, additional methods—such as DCF analysis grounded in commercial milestones, precedent transaction analysis within autonomous systems, or revenue multiple frameworks calibrated to disclosed comparables—would be required. Without application of these alternative methodologies, no valuation point estimate or range can be supported by the current dataset.
